title: UserProvisioningRequestDataType
description: Schema for a UserProvisioning request payload, including optional response metadata for status reporting.
x-ecohub-license: © 2025 EcoHub AG. Usage restricted. Prior written authorization required. Swiss law applies. Jurisdiction: Zurich.

idpUserId.description: IDP_UserID. This ID is unique across all users within EcoHub.

userIsConsulting.description: Flag that indicates if the user is actually doing any advisory work for the customers.

userIsFINMARegistered.description: Flag that indicates if the user is personally registered at FINMA (i.e. has a FINMA number).

igRoles.description: IGB2B roles assigned to the user on EcoHub.

vuRights.description: VU rights assigned to the user for the receiving service provider on EcoHub.

orgId.description: The unique ID of the member organization.

orgRegNo.description: Old primary register number of the organizational unit.

currentOrgRegNo.description: Current primary register number of the organizational unit.

primaryOU.description: Information about the primary organizational unit.

additionalOU.description: Information about other organizational units. The list can contain the primary organizational unit and can be empty.

employed.description: Flag that indicates whether the user is employed by the member (true) or whether it is an external employee (false).

userOfficePhone.description: User's office phone number in standard international format (e.g. +41441234567).

userMobilePhone.description: User's cell phone number in international standard format (e.g. +41791234567).

userBirthday.description: Date of birth of the user.

userSex.description: Gender of the user. Allowed values are "M" and "F".

userLanguage.description: Two-character ISO language code of the initial administrator's correspondence language.

validFrom.description: The date and time from which the user is considered valid for the membership or service agreement.

validTo.description: The date and time until which the user is considered valid. In the current implementation, this field is always null.

userType.description: User type (technical user or natural user).

userCategory.description: User category: Indicates the type of user.

requestId.description: Unique request ID within EcoHub. This is logged on EcoHub and can be helpful for troubleshooting.

creationDate.description: Time at which the user was created on EcoHub (date and time down to milliseconds, time zone independent).

creationUser.description: Name of the user who created the user on EcoHub.

modificationDate.description: Time when the user was last changed on EcoHub (date and time down to milliseconds, time zone independent).

modificationUser.description: Name of the user who last changed the user on EcoHub.

requestTime.description: Time of the request as timestamp (date and time down to milliseconds, time zone independent).

returnCode.description: Indicates whether the request was processed successfully. Possible values are described in the protocol specification.

errorMessage.description: Optional information in case of error. Should make it easier to find the cause of the error and contains textual (not further structured) data.

regNo.description: Old register number of the organizational unit.

currentRegNo.description: Current register number of the organizational unit.

type.description: Type of organizational unit. Current known values: headquarter, branch, subsidiary, subbroker.

name.description: Name of the OU (informative only, must not be used to identify the OU).
